shayari:
na jaane kis ki hamein umr bhar talaash rahi
jise qareeb se dekha vo doosra nikla
author: Bu Khalilur Rahman Azmi
reflection: A reminder that sometimes we fall in love with an idea rather than the person.

shayari:
ek rasm-e-sarfaroshi thi so rukhsat ho gai
yun to deewane hamare baad bhi aaye bahut
author: Mahtab Zafar
reflection: Some people are irreplaceable even when many others come afterward.
